div.div: Covers guard, maintenance, committee and manager accounts; a household's account is in the Resident part. The administrator creates and deactivates the manager's account (ADM-01). Deactivation is refused for a maintenance worker who still has Assigned, In progress or On hold tickets, and for the manager's own account. Deactivating a guard removes their future shifts (BM-02). Wrong passwords block only the device, or the username on the gate device (BR-14), so there is no Locked state.
